description: Warm campaign source: reads the user's own LinkedIn first-degree connections (free, from the LinkedIn account the user connected to Nock; never anyone else's network) into a new people sheet in the user's workspace, newest first, keeping those whose headline has any of the keywords (their ICP's titles or sectors). Only the professional profile LinkedIn shows a connection (name, headline, profile URL), at most 1000 per call. For a campaign with people who already know the user (their connections, their network). It says itself when no LinkedIn is connected or which account to pick, so no sender check is needed before it. Returns how many were read and kept, a sample and the sheet. A message to someone already connected needs no invite and gets more replies. LinkedIn does not share who viewed the profile through this account, so that is not available.

accountId.description: The LinkedIn account when the workspace has more than one.

keywords.description: Words to keep connections whose headline has any of them (titles, sectors, companies): e.g. ["CEO", "fundador", "diretor comercial", "varejo"]. Empty keeps all.

max.description: How many recent connections to read (default 500, at most 1000).
